name: Persistent plan-review status card with reject-with-reason and regenerate actions
testIds: PlanVerdictBox — status rendering > renders the matching icon+label pair for $status

PlanVerdictBox — reject form > calls onReject with the trimmed reason on submit
PlanVerdictBox — reject form > returns focus to the Request Changes toggle button on Cancel

PlanVerdictBox — regenerate button > shows the persisted rejection reason in changes_requested state
